UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026: Application Deadline Extended to November 4 for 12,405 Posts

Key takeawaysThe Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has announced an extension for the application window of its primary teacher recruitment drive. Under Advt. No. 05/2026, the commission aims to fill 12,405 Assistant Teacher (PRT) positions across the sta

The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has announced an extension for the application window of its primary teacher recruitment drive. Under Advt. No. 05/2026, the commission aims to fill 12,405 Assistant Teacher (PRT) positions across the state. Candidates interested in applying can now submit their forms online until November 4, 2026.

Key Dates and Schedule

The application process commenced on September 16, 2026. Following the recent extension, both the final date for online registrations and the corresponding fee payment deadline have been set for November 4, 2026. Applicants are encouraged to complete their submissions ahead of the cutoff to avoid potential technical congestion on the portal.

Eligibility and Qualifications

To qualify for the UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher positions under Advt. No. 05/2026, candidates must fulfill specific educational and age criteria:

  • Educational Qualifications: Applicants need a graduation degree from a recognized university established by law in India. Additionally, candidates must possess a recognized teacher-training credential such as BTC, BTC (Urdu), Special BTC, a 2-year Diploma in Special Education (approved by the RCI), a 4-year B.El.Ed., or a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) under NCTE regulations. Passing the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Classes 1 to 5, conducted by either the State Government or the Government of India, is also mandatory.
  • Age Limits: The standard minimum age is 21 years, while the maximum age limit is generally 40 years as of July 1, 2026. For specific categories like Assistant Teacher (Attached Primary), the maximum age limit extends up to 62 years. Age relaxations are applicable per the regulations set by UPESSC.

Practical Implications and Verification

Applicants should carefully review the official guidelines and verify all parameters before submitting their forms.

  • Confirmed Details: A total of 12,405 vacancies are open, with the application deadline officially extended to November 4, 2026. The age calculation reference date is July 1, 2026.
  • Unknown/Unspecified Details: Exact exam dates, shift timings, and detailed selection stage schedules beyond the application phase were not detailed in the initial recruitment notice.
  • How to Verify: Readers can check the official announcement, review detailed notifications, and access the application portal directly via the [UPESSC Official Website](https://upessc.up.gov.in/).
